planned_path.path_summary: Regress Manifesto-method plurality-winner distance from the median voter on an SMD indicator, adjusting for decade fixed effects and clustering standard errors by country.

path_signature.sample_restriction: Rows with election rule coded smd or pr and nonmissing variables required by the model.
path_signature.missing_data_rule: Listwise deletion for pldist1, smd, decade, and country.
path_signature.variable_construction: Clean smd labels, create binary SMD indicator, create categorical decade.
path_signature.inference_rule: Expected direction is negative. Expected direction with p <= 0.05 is support; 0.05 < p <= 0.055 is borderline support only for a meaningful estimate whose interval narrowly crosses the null; clearly weak aligned evidence is inconclusive; affirmative positive coefficient with p < 0.05 and interval above zero is opposite.
path_signature.estimand_quantity: Decade-adjusted coefficient on smd_bin from OLS, interpreted as the mean difference in pldist1 for SMD versus PR elections conditional on decade.
path_signature.contrast: SMD election-rule observations versus PR election-rule observations.
path_signature.target_population: Authorized Powell election observations with smd or pr election-rule coding.

execution_result.status_reason: The agent followed the planned Task1 path exactly: pldist1 was regressed on smd_bin with decade fixed effects and country-clustered standard errors. No implementation repairs or analysis changes were made.

planned_path.path_summary: Use the instructed 1945-2003 Manifesto-method data and estimate the simple SMD-vs-PR difference in plurality-winner distance from the median voter.

path_signature.sample_restriction: Years 1945-2003 inclusive, rows with election rule coded smd or pr, and nonmissing focal variables.
path_signature.missing_data_rule: Listwise deletion for pldist1, smd, and year.
path_signature.variable_construction: Clean smd labels and create binary SMD indicator.
path_signature.inference_rule: Expected direction is negative. Expected direction with p <= 0.05 is support; 0.05 < p <= 0.055 is borderline support only for a meaningful estimate whose interval narrowly crosses the null; clearly weak aligned evidence is inconclusive; affirmative positive coefficient with p < 0.05 and interval above zero is opposite.
path_signature.estimand_quantity: Coefficient on smd_bin from OLS, interpreted as the mean Manifesto-method pldist1 difference for SMD versus PR elections during 1945-2003.
path_signature.contrast: SMD election-rule observations versus PR election-rule observations.
path_signature.target_population: Authorized Powell election observations from 1945 through 2003 with smd or pr election-rule coding.

execution_result.status_reason: The agent followed the planned Task2 path exactly: the analysis used the authorized 1945-2003 Manifesto-method data, constructed smd_bin, and estimated pldist1 ~ smd_bin with HC1 robust standard errors. No implementation repairs or analysis changes were made.
